categories.main_business_segments: AICHI CORPORATION operates primarily in two business segments: (1) Special-purpose vehicles, including aerial work platforms and pole erection vehicles for electric, telecommunication, and construction industries, and (2) Parts and repair services, providing after-sales support, maintenance, and training related to these vehicles. The company also engages in the manufacture and sale of skid steer loaders and offers training services for aerial work platforms.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company specializes in the design and manufacture of high-reliability aerial work platforms and special-purpose vehicles, leveraging advanced hydraulic, electronic, and safety control technologies. Production methods emphasize high-mix, multi-purpose, and multi-functional product development tailored to various industry needs, with a focus on quality management and continuous improvement (TPS education, skill competitions, and internal initiatives). Manufacturing is conducted at domestic plants in Japan and through subsidiaries in China.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include companies in the electric power, telecommunications, general construction, and logistics industries, as well as rental companies. The main end markets are infrastructure construction and maintenance, utility work, and industrial applications requiring safe and efficient elevated work solutions.
categories.geographic_coverage: AICHI CORPORATION's primary market is Japan, which accounts for over 90% of sales, but it also operates in Asia (notably China) and Oceania (New Zealand), with manufacturing and sales subsidiaries in these regions. The company is actively seeking to expand its overseas sales, leveraging partnerships with trading companies such as Itochu Corporation.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates midstream and downstream in the supply chain, manufacturing finished special-purpose vehicles and providing after-sales services, parts, and training directly to end users and distributors. It also supplies some products on an OEM basis to parent and partner companies.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding sales through environmentally friendly and safety-focused products, entering the maintenance lease and used vehicle businesses, and enhancing global market presence via synergies with Itochu Corporation. R&D focuses on mechanization, labor-saving, and safety improvements for construction and utility work, as well as developing advanced, multi-functional, and eco-friendly models. The company is also investing in new production facilities aimed at CO2 neutrality and productivity breakthroughs.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated from the sale of new special-purpose vehicles (aerial work platforms, pole erection vehicles), parts and repair services, and training programs. Additional revenue streams include OEM supply to partners, and the company is developing maintenance lease and used vehicle businesses for recurring income.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: AICHI CORPORATION is the leading manufacturer of aerial work platforms in Japan, maintaining a high domestic market share. Its main competitors are other special-purpose vehicle manufacturers, both domestic and international, with competition centered on price, product reliability, and after-sales service. The company differentiates itself through comprehensive lifecycle value, 24-hour service support, and strong customer relationships.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending March 2025, consolidated net sales were approximately 59.3 billion yen, with operating income of 7.4 billion yen and net income attributable to shareholders of 6.3 billion yen. The company has demonstrated stable profitability and a strong balance sheet, with a recent growth trend (sales up 12% and net income up 20% year-on-year), and targets further expansion to 83 billion yen in sales by FY2029.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: AICHI CORPORATION emphasizes safety, reliability, and lifecycle value in its products, supporting customers with advanced technology, robust after-sales service, and training. Its unique value lies in its ability to provide comprehensive solutions for safe and efficient elevated work, rapid service response, and continuous innovation in eco-friendly and high-productivity equipment.
